text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
During summer training camp. One day, 
while she was immersed in her training.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: A hike—you say?

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! Want to go for a change of pace? I 
invited Loves-chan and Chrono-chan too, so 
the five of us!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
I heard the view from the top of the hill 
is super pretty. What do you think?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She decided to go on a hiking trip with 
her peers.

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: The wind feels soooo good~!

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
My, what a vast colony of narcissus 
anemones— Harmonizing with the summer 
meadow, it's so beautiful.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
Fufu... The view is lovely, too. I should 
have brought a telescope.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Still, we've walked quite a bit, haven't 
we! Shall we take a short break?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Since it was a hike, I had prepared some 
light snacks.
choice_data_list:
With the sweetness of strawberries, my 
energy is increased a hundredfold!

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: Thank you very much. Down the hatch!

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
I'm sorry... To think you'd treat us as 
well.
choice_data_list:
Don't worry about it, eat as much as you 
like.
Don't worry about it, eat up!

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: ...! You're very skilled, aren't you?

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
I knew you made bento lunches for 
Bouquet-san for a time, but I never 
imagined it was to this extent...

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
Fufu... Somehow, I've found myself feeling 
a little envious.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, that's right! She made such careful, 
elaborate bento lunches for me every 
single day. And yet, she never once 
complained—

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
I'm so glad you got to see what a 
wonderful person she is.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
While enjoying a pleasant and peaceful 
time together around some light snacks...

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: Yeah. It really is delicious.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Oh, it's so sweet and delicious! Isn't it 
rather rare for this time of year? It 
tastes just like in-season strawberries.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
In truth, in order to add variety to 
Curren Bouquetd'or's summer snacks, they 
had been ordered from a cooler region.

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Is that so! You sure are passionate, 
Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: I can feel the love from this strawberry♡

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: L-Love—!

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: ...Fufu.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
While enjoying a pleasant and peaceful 
time together around some light snacks...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A notification chime rang for a new email. 
Just to be sure, I checked the subject 
line, and—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I wondered if something had happened. 
Excusing myself, I briefly checked the 
contents—

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
"Notice! The Exhibition Match has been 
officially scheduled!"

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: "What's going on!? Is something wrong?"

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
"Lately, Tiara Umamusume have been making 
huge waves! Led by the likes of Gran 
Alegria and Loves Only You—"

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
"This year's Triple Tiara campaign is once 
again seeing incredible excitement!"

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
"Therefore, this coming November! Hosted 
by Tracen Academy!"

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
"An exhibition match gathering top Tiara 
Umamusume has officially been decided!"

text_block_list.name: The Four
text_block_list.text: Huh!?

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
"First, we are seeking participants! For 
details, please refer to this special 
page—"

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: The Tiara Umamusume Exhibition Match—!

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
Indeed, it's rare for the Tiara route to 
draw this much attention.

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Isn't this amazing!? It totally is, right! 
I'm so happy~!

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
Yes, very much so. November means— it'll 
take place after the Shuka Sho, right?

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Hehe! That means it's the grand finale of 
the Triple Tiara route, huh♪

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
You're right! Aha, I'm too excited to sit 
still!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Let's hurry and go! I feel like shouting 
at the top of my lungs from the summit!

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: Fufu, I'll be going ahead then♡

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: Ah, no fair! Me too!

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: Shall we head out too?

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: Yes— Trainer, are you alright?
choice_data_list:
Maybe we should take the ski lift from 
here.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I didn't want to get in the way of those 
itching to run. Luckily, there happened to 
be a ski lift boarding area nearby.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
"Oh, is that so? Understood, please take 
care."

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
(—An exhibition match... The Tiara route 
must be getting that much excitement.)

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
(I'm sure the day of the event will be 
lively with a huge crowd as well――)

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
(Could this be... a great opportunity to 
make Trainer known to everyone?)

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
Yeah— From now on, I have to do my very, 
very best.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
"...Haa, phew. It's getting a bit steep, 
isn't it?"

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: L-Let's slow the pace down a bit~!

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: ...? Yes, of course—!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After reaching the top via the lift, the 
Umamusume came running up the hill one 
after another shortly after.

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
*gasp*, *pant*! *pant*, *whew*~~! W-We 
made it~! Good job on the 30 miles~!

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha..., I guess I pushed a bit too hard 
right at the start.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
"That final steep slope went straight to 
my legs..."

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: Is everyone all right?

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
"Yes. Um, Bouquet-san is... quite tough, 
isn't she—"
choice_data_list:
(True enough, she isn't out of breath in 
the slightest.)

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: Is that... so...?

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: Waah! What a beautiful view...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Gran Alegria's voice echoed through the 
air. Drawn by her call, I looked down from 
the hilltop.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Amidst the lush greenery, rocks were 
scattered here and there— and a gust of 
wind swept across them."

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
"The high sky... There's a subtle scent of 
autumn in the air, isn't there?"

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
...Come autumn, there's the Shuka Sho. And 
then, the exhibition match...

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Yes! I'm so excited already, I can't sit 
still♪

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
"Right! Let's make this the best race 
ever, everyone!"

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: —Yes, that's right.
